factories.name: Nyansiongo
factories.notes: KTDA lists under Nyamira County: 'situated in Borabu District, Nyanza Province', 36 km from Kisii town. Tea Board of Kenya also lists county Nyamira. Named in KTDA Zone 10 (Nyamira) notice, Feb 2026.

factories.name: Sanganyi
factories.notes: KTDA: 'situated in Nyaramba Shopping Centre, Ekerenyo Sub-county of Nyamira County'. Tea Board lists Nyamira. Spelled 'Sang'anyi' in some media. Ward not stated (Nyaramba is a shopping centre, not confirmed as ward).

factories.name: Kebirigo
factories.notes: KTDA: 'located in Kebirigo Sub-location, Bonyamatuta Masaba Location, Nyamira Division, of Nyamira District'; serves West Mugirango, North Mugirango and West Kitutu constituencies. Tea Board lists Nyamira. Spelled 'Kiberigo'/'Kibirigo' in some media.

factories.name: Nyankoba
factories.notes: KTDA gives only coordinates ('approx. 34.9 degrees East and 0.8 degrees South ... 2160m above sea level'), listed under Nyamira County. Tea Board lists Nyamira.

factories.name: Tombe
factories.notes: CONFLICT: KTDA factory site says 'located in Tombe Market, Bonyamondo sub-location, Manga division, Manga District in Nyamira County'; Tea Board of Kenya manufacturers list gives county 'Kisii'. Not named in the Feb 2026 Zone 10 (Nyamira) monthly-rate notice. KTDA June 2022 table groups it as 'TOMBE/SOMBOGO'.

factories.name: Gianchore
factories.notes: KTDA lists under Nyamira County heading only; no sub-county given. Tea Board lists Nyamira.

factories.name: Matunwa
factories.notes: Not in the original candidate list. Tea Board lists 'Matunwa Tea Factory Co. Ltd' as KTDA Managed, county Nyamira (and as Specialty with county column 'Nyansiogo'). KNA describes it as 'a satellite of Nyansiongo Tea Factory in Nyamira County' producing orthodox tea. No separate payout figures found.

factories.name: Itumbe
factories.notes: NOT Nyamira. KTDA: 'located in Kenyerere sub location, Mokwerero location, Sameta sub-county in Kisii County.' Paired with Nyamache in KTDA tables.

factories.name: Rianyamwamu
factories.notes: NOT Nyamira. KTDA lists under Kisii County, 'located in Kisii central district', 15 km from Kisii town.

factories.name: Eberege
factories.notes: NOT Nyamira. KTDA: 'located in Kenyenya sub-county, Kisii County'.

factories.name: Kiamokama
factories.notes: NOT Nyamira. KTDA factory site: 'in Masimba area, Kiamokama Division, Masaba South District in Kisii County.' (Site contains injected casino spam.)
